subject: gk
question: Who propounded the philosophy of ‘One Caste, One Religion, One God for all men’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sree Narayana Guru**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sree Narayana Guru__:

 __
 
• Great social leader born on August 20, 1856, at Chempazhanthy, Travancore,
 
• Famous for movements against caste discrimination and advocated for social equality.
 
• In 1927 he consecrated the first mirror at Kalavancode temple with the message “Om Shanthi” written on the surface of the mirror. 
 
• The historical Aruvippuram prathishta was done by Sree Narayana Guru in 1888.
 
• He was considered as the Father of the Modern Renaissance in Kerala.
 
• Famous words: One Caste, One Religion, One God for All.
 
• Important works: Daiva Dasakam, Gajendramoksham Vanjipaatu.
 
• Died on September 20, 1928, at Sivagiri.
 
• **Narayana Guru** preached the doctrine of **“One Caste One Religion, One God for Man”**.
 
• **Sree Narayana Guru's attitude toward religion is worth elaboration because of his profound scholarship, incisive intellect, and independent thinking.**
 
• **This is the only religion, according to the Guru. In the concept of religion, the Guru tried to reveal the essential oneness of all religions.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ** Raja Ram Mohan Roy****​**

 
 
• Raja Ram Mohan Roy was the first social reformer to view modern education as a vehicle for the spread of modern ideas in the country.
 
• He believed that education could play a crucial role in the development of the country and the upliftment of its people.
 
• He established the Hindu College in Calcutta in 1817, which later became the nucleus of the University of Calcutta.
 
• He also advocated for the education of women and girls, and supported the idea of English education.
 
 
 
• **Savitribai Phule****​**
 
 
• Savitri Bai Phule was an Indian social reformer, educationist and poetess from Maharashtra.
 
• She was the first woman teacher in India in 1848.
 
• She was a trailblazer in providing education for girls and for ostracized portions of society.
 
• She opened a school for girls with her husband, Jyotirao Phule.
 
• They found one of the first modern Indian girls' schools in Pune at Bhide Wada.
 
• Savitribai Phule even worked to abolish discrimination and unfair treatment of people based on caste and gender.
 
 
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi **
 
 
• Mahatma Gandhi wrote Hind Swaraj in 1908 during his return visit to South Africa from India via London by ship.
 
• Hind Swaraj highlights all of Gandhi's basic principles, including the relationship between ends and means, between rights and duties, and between religious communities, as well as his concepts of history, nationality, dissent, education, and technology.
